rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday word for a shop that sells books.

example.english: I went to the bookshop to buy a novel.
example.jyutping: ngo5 heoi3 syu1 dim3 maai5 bun2 siu2 syut3

rows.note: A speaker often picks this Hong Kong term for a traditional or established bookshop, especially one selling schoolbooks.

example.english: Before school starts, we go to the bookshop to buy textbooks.
example.traditional: 開學前，我哋去書局買課本。
example.jyutping: hoi1 hok6 cin4 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 syu1 guk6 maai5 fo3 bun2
